catalogue.title: Run timeline — created, run, analysis, last change
catalogue.note: Every dated event the file carries: experiment creation, run start and end, analysis creation and edits, the last recorded change (for .eds, the newest ZIP entry date is the last save), instrument log and calibrations. Events more than 7 days from the run are listed in the table and marked at the edge.

catalogue.title: Amplification curves coloured by SOP outcome
catalogue.note: Stored curves of the selected target. Colour = outcome under the active SOP; dashed vertical lines = SOP Cq cut-off and late-signal limit; horizontal line = stored threshold (QuantStudio ΔRn).

catalogue.title: Plate heat map
catalogue.note: Every physical position. Choose what the colour shows: SOP outcome, stored Cq, end fluorescence, background, amplitude, or analysis status (which also shows wells with signal that are in no analysis, and omitted wells).

catalogue.title: Signal in wells that are not in any analysis
catalogue.note: Rising fluorescence in positions that carry no result (unnamed wells, wells left out of every analysis, or wells without a target). These are the places where a sample may have been run but not reported.

catalogue.title: Cq by target with SOP cut-offs
catalogue.note: One point per well. Colour by SOP outcome or by role. Red dashed line: Cq cut-off; orange: late-signal limit (per target).

catalogue.title: Replicate spread — mean Cq against SD
catalogue.note: One point per sample and target with two or more detected replicates. The dashed line is the SOP maximum SD.

catalogue.title: Standard curve with residuals and SOP limits
catalogue.note: Cq against log10 of the stored standard quantity, fitted by least squares on this page. The label shows slope, R², efficiency and range against the SOP limits; residuals are in the table.

catalogue.title: Internal control / reference Cq per sample (inhibition)
catalogue.note: Cq of the targets the SOP marks as internal control or reference. The band is the run median ± the SOP maximum IC shift; points above it suggest inhibition or low input.

catalogue.title: Fluorescence level against Cq
catalogue.note: End-point fluorescence (or amplitude above background) against the stored Cq. Late, low-plateau curves separate from true amplification; undetected wells are drawn at the right edge.

catalogue.title: Background and plateau fluorescence per channel
catalogue.note: For each detection channel / target: background (mean of cycles 3–10) and end-point fluorescence of every well, including wells outside the analyses. A shifted background points to plate, seal or optical problems.

catalogue.title: SOP outcomes per target
catalogue.note: Number of sample/target results per outcome under the active SOP, controls included.

catalogue.title: Block, cover and zone temperature (QuantStudio log)
catalogue.note: From the instrument log inside the .eds file: sample block mean, heated cover and the spread between block zones, against minutes from the first record. The dashed line is the SOP maximum zone spread.

catalogue.title: Stored Ct against the Ct re-derived on this page
catalogue.note: QuantStudio only: difference between the stored Ct and the crossing of the stored ΔRn with the stored threshold. Differences beyond ±0.2 require an algorithm/settings/provenance review; they do not prove that stored data were edited.

catalogue.title: Block temperature trace (LightCycler temperature log)
catalogue.note: The block temperature the LightCycler 480 logged about every 0.41 s, decoded from the TemperatureLog inside the .ixo file, with the protocol setpoints. Heating and cooling rates, overshoot, settling and transition times on the control panel are measured on the full trace; the graph keeps the lowest and highest value of every time slice, so overshoots and short holds are not lost when it is thinned for display.

catalogue.title: Runs on a calendar — run time and last change
catalogue.note: Each run as a green dot at its start, with the experiment creation (blue, above) and the last recorded change (red, below, joined by a dashed line). Long gaps between run and last change are the first thing an auditor asks about.

catalogue.title: Hours from run end to the last recorded change
catalogue.note: Processing time per run. The dashed line is the SOP maximum; bars above it are flagged in the run acceptance.

catalogue.title: Run acceptance grid
catalogue.note: Runs (rows) against the SOP criteria (columns): green met, amber review, red rejected, grey not applicable.

catalogue.title: SOP outcomes per run
catalogue.note: Stacked counts of sample/target outcomes for every loaded run.

catalogue.title: Control Cq across runs with SOP range
catalogue.note: Descriptive control overview. Solid band: configured SOP range. No pooled statistical limits; use extraction-batch charts for comparable groups.

catalogue.title: Background and plateau fluorescence across runs
catalogue.note: Median background and median end-point fluorescence of every channel per run: slow drift here is an instrument or reagent trend.

catalogue.title: Run duration and instrument use
catalogue.note: Minutes from run start to run end, coloured by instrument. A run much shorter than its siblings with the same protocol deserves a look at the log.

catalogue.title: Forensic findings by area (Pareto)
catalogue.note: Count of error and review findings in the forensic log, grouped by area, largest first.

catalogue.title: Control extraction batches
catalogue.note: Descriptive association only. Separate material, extraction batch, dilution, target, instrument and protocol. Missing/invalid extraction dates are excluded from age plots.

catalogue.title: Control extract age versus Cq
catalogue.note: Descriptive association only. Separate material, extraction batch, dilution, target, instrument and protocol. Missing/invalid extraction dates are excluded from age plots.

catalogue.title: Control Cq versus cooling rate
catalogue.note: Descriptive association only. Separate material, extraction batch, dilution, target, instrument and protocol. Missing/invalid extraction dates are excluded from age plots.

catalogue.title: Stored Cq values
catalogue.note: One row per stored result with well, sample, target, role and call.

catalogue.title: Melting peaks
catalogue.note: One row per stored peak with temperature, area, width and height.

catalogue.title: Experiment settings
catalogue.note: Every setting read out of the container, with the property it came from.

catalogue.title: Plate map
catalogue.note: The plate as the file describes it: position, sample, target and role.

catalogue.title: Statistics
catalogue.note: Per target and group: counts, mean Cq, spread and detection.

catalogue.title: Runs and quality control
catalogue.note: One row per run with its profile answer and the reason behind it.

catalogue.title: Forensic findings
catalogue.note: Every finding with its area, severity and the evidence behind it.

catalogue.title: Control chart points
catalogue.note: The plotted points of the control series with their limits.

catalogue.title: Amplification curves
catalogue.note: The fluorescence of every well, one row per cycle.

catalogue.title: Profile answers
catalogue.note: What the laboratory profile concluded for every sample.
